text: dsh-plugin-quick-resume 是面向 DSH Web 的输入框快捷语插件，在会话输入框底栏添加按钮，点击后向当前会话发送预设或自定义短语。默认提供继续、改写表达和翻译按钮；齿轮设置面板可编辑标签、图标和发送内容，添加或删除按钮并恢复默认，最多八个。它适合希望快速发送常用提示、唤醒或引导当前会话的 DSH Web 用户。源码未读取 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

dsh-plugin-quick-resume adds quick phrase buttons to the DSH Web composer. A click sends a preset or custom message to the current conversation. Users can edit labels, icons, and phrases, add or remove buttons, and reset defaults. It helps quickly guide or resume a conversation.
想给 DSH 输入框加几个一键发送常用提示的按钮。
DSH 里的 agent 停住了，怎样快速发一句请继续？
我想在每个会话里快速发送翻译或解释短语。
dsh-plugin-quick-resume 的功能「会话快捷语发送」：在输入框底栏显示短语按钮，点击后通过当前会话的发送接口提交消息；默认短语可用于继续、改写表达或翻译。
dsh-plugin-quick-resume 的功能「快捷按钮配置」：打开齿轮设置面板后，可编辑按钮标签、短语和图标，添加、删除按钮或恢复默认；最多保存八个按钮。
dsh-plugin-quick-resume 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 12 天；提交数 2；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · 为什么做它：网络抖一下、模型超时、审批卡住……agent 常常就停在半路上。要让它继续，你得回到输入框、一个字一个字敲「请继续」，一天下来这件事能重复几十次。

这个插件把它变成输入框里的一个按钮，顺便把其他常用的催促 / 纠偏话术也做成了一排：

- **不打断你**：发送走宿主公开的 `conversation.send()`，和手动敲回车完全等价；不会往编辑器里塞文字，已经写了一半的草稿原样保留。
- **每个会话都能用**：按钮挂在会话作用域里，切换对话各自独立、不会发错窗口。
- **不够用就自己加**：按钮个数、文字、图标、发送内容都能改，配置只存在你本机。

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · 功能：- 输入框底栏一排快捷语按钮，默认三颗，**每个会话各有一套**
- 自定义设置浮层：按钮文字、发送内容、图标随意改；增删按钮（最多 8 颗）、一键恢复默认
- 图标选择器：10 个单色线性图标，点图标选图标，不再有下拉框里的文字
- 发送反馈：转圈 → 绿色对勾；失败变红抖动，并在输入框上方弹出失败提示
- 跟随宿主主题：只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，亮色 / 暗色都不突兀
- 窄屏自适应：输入框宽度小于 660px 时自动收起按钮文字，只留图标
- 纯本地、零网络请求、零遥测：配置存在浏览器 `localStorage`

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · 使用：默认三颗按钮：

| 图标 | 文字 | 点一下发送 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 火箭 | 继续 | `请继续` |
| 对话气泡 | 说人话 | `说人话，我看不懂` |
| 地球 | 翻译 | `翻译成中文` |

点这一排最右边的**齿轮**，会在按钮上方弹出设置浮层（点浮层外面或按 `Esc` 收起）：

- **图标**：点当前的图标方块，展开 10 个单色图标，点哪个用哪个
- **按钮文字**：显示在按钮上的短标签；留空则只显示图标
- **发送内容**：点一下真正发出去的那句话，任意文本
- **删除** / **+ 添加按钮**（上限 8 颗）/ **恢复默认**

所有改动即时生效、即时保存，不需要重启或刷新。

配置存储位置：浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `dsh.quick-resume.buttons.v1`（按浏览器 / 站点隔离，不上传）。

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · 工作原理：- **挂载点**：`conversation.input.left`——输入框卡片内部底栏工具行，紧跟在 `＋`、权限、计划这些控件之后。
- **发送**：在会话作用域里取 `conversation` 服务，调用 `conversation.send(text)`；它内部是 `session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')`，也就是一条普通用户消息，agent 空闲时立即唤醒、运行中则排队。
- **会话寻址**：使用本地 `sessionId` 找 `sessions.scope(id)`，点击时才解析，不在多个会话之间缓存，保证发到当前这个对话。
- **没有 Host 工具**：纯 UI 动作，只由用户点击触发，不向模型暴露任何新工具。

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · 兼容性：- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0`，仅 Web 端（`dsh.web`）
- 只在存在打开会话的输入框里渲染（新会话首页不显示）
- 宿主在**语音输入 / activity 展开**时会隐藏整个底栏工具行，这几秒按钮会跟着暂时消失，收起后回来——这是宿主行为，不是插件掉了

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · dsh-quick-resume：> A row of quick-phrase buttons in the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) web composer: one click sends "keep going", "speak plainly", "translate to Chinese", or any phrase you define — so a stalled agent keeps working without you retyping, and without touching your draft.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-quick-resume)
[](LICENSE)
[](#compatibility)

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Why：A flaky network, a model timeout, or a pending approval can leave an agent stopped halfway. To nudge it, you go back to the composer and type "please continue" — dozens of times a day.

This plugin turns that into a button, and gives you a row for the other phrases you keep typing:

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Why：- **Non-intrusive**: it sends through the host's public `conversation.send()`, exactly like pressing Enter; nothing is written into the editor, and your half-written draft stays untouched.
- **Per conversation**: the row lives in the session scope, so switching conversations never sends into the wrong one.
- **Yours to shape**: button count, labels, icons, and the phrases themselves are editable; the layout stays on your machine.

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Features：- A quick-phrase row in the composer's bottom tool row, three buttons by default, **one set per conversation**
- Settings popover: edit labels, sent phrases, and icons; add/remove buttons (up to 8); restore defaults
- Icon picker: 10 single-color line icons — pick an icon, no text dropdown
- Send feedback: spinner → green check; failures turn red and shake, plus a toast above the composer
- Follows the host theme: only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, works in light and dark
- Narrow-screen friendly: labels collapse to icon-only below 660px of composer width
- Local only: no network calls, no telemetry, layout stored in `localStorage`

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Usage：The three default buttons:

| Icon | Label | Sends |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rocket | 继续 | `请继续` |
| Speech bubble | 说人话 | `说人话，我看不懂` |
| Globe | 翻译 | `翻译成中文` |

Click the **gear** at the end of the row to open the settings popover above the buttons (click outside or press `Esc` to close):

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Usage：- **Icon**: click the icon chip, pick from 10 single-color glyphs
- **Button text**: the short label on the pill; leave empty for icon-only
- **Message to send**: the exact text one click sends, any content
- **Remove** / **+ Add button** (max 8) / **Restore defaults**

Changes apply and persist immediately — no restart or refresh.

Stored in `localStorage` under `dsh.quick-resume.buttons.v1` (per browser and origin, never uploaded).

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · How it works：- **Mount point**: `conversation.input.left` — the composer card's bottom tool row, right after the `+`, permission, and plan controls.
- **Sending**: resolves the session-scoped `conversation` service and calls `conversation.send(text)`, which is `session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')` — an ordinary user message that wakes an idle agent immediately and queues while one is running.
- **Session addressing**: the local `sessionId` is resolved to `sessions.scope(id)` at click time, never cached across conversations.
- **No host tools**: purely a UI action, only triggered by the user; nothing new is exposed to the model.

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Compatibility：- DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0`, web client only (`dsh.web`)
- Renders only when a conversation is open (not on the new-session hero screen)
- The host hides the whole bottom tool row while voice input / activity is expanded; the buttons disappear for those moments and come back — host behavior, not a crash

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Project layout：| File | Purpose |

| `package.json` | bundle manifest: `dsh.bundle.patch` (installable) + `dsh.client` (web half) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the `quick-resume` row into a profile |
| `index.js` | host half: empty `apply()` so the bundle is a normal, listable plugin |
| `client.js` | everything: locale dictionaries, row, settings popover, localStorage, sending |
| `locale/zh.json`, `locale/en.json` | market card title and description |
| `icon.svg` | plugin icon (the `icon` field read by the 36px plugin card) |
| `docs/screenshots/` | README screenshots |
| `verify/smoke.mjs` | zero-dependency checks: manifest contract, files, syntax, locales, icon, patch |
| `LICENSE` / `CHANGELOG.md` | MIT license and version history |

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Development：Pure client-side bundle, no build step. The host hot-reloads client modules (`client-hmr` polls the bundle file every 500ms), so editing `client.js` and refreshing the page is enough.

```bash
node verify/smoke.mjs   # manifest + syntax + icon + patch checks (also runs on npm publish)
```

Factory defaults live in `client.js`:

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Development：- `DEFAULT_BUTTONS` — `icon` / `label` / `phrase` of the shipped three
- `MAX_BUTTONS` — row limit (8)
- `GLYPHS` + `ICON_NAMES` — single-color path set; add a name to expose it in the picker

dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Privacy：- No network requests, no telemetry, no reading of conversation content
- The only persisted data is the button layout in local `localStorage`
- All sent phrases are authored by you; the plugin ships no tracking
dsh-plugin-quick-resume README · Contributing：Issues and PRs are welcome. Describe the use case first; for interaction changes a screenshot or short recording makes review much faster.
